long_horizon_tracking.description: Long-horizon 6DoF tactile tracking with continuous contact (paper Section V, Table IV). Held-out test: 192 synthetic GelSight-Mini-style episodes of 400 frames over four texture families, rendered only inside eval/test/. The scaled gym reference and frozen baseline are in results; unchanged real-data paper numbers are under _paper_results.

rotation_mae_deg.description: Mean absolute rotation error, averaged over the three Euler axes (theta_x, theta_y, theta_z) and over frames, of sensor poses relative to the first frame; averaged over the continuous-contact episodes. Same statistic as the paper's Table IV.

translation_mae_mm.description: Mean absolute translation error in millimetres, averaged over x, y, z and over frames, relative to the first frame; averaged over the continuous-contact episodes (Table IV statistic).

rotation_p95_deg.description: 95th percentile over all frames of the continuous-contact episodes of the geodesic rotation error (capped at 90 deg); catches tracking failures hidden by the mean.

translation_p95_mm.description: 95th percentile over all frames of the continuous-contact episodes of the translation error norm in millimetres (capped at 30 mm).

false_loop_excess.description: Constraint: fraction of the method's reported frame-pair relations (one record per frame pair) whose relative pose disagrees with ground truth by more than 1 mm or 5 deg (malformed, non-finite, impossible or duplicate records fail the run), minus a 2% allowance for the verification tolerance, floored at 0. Methods that report no relations score 0. If more than 10% of a method's relations within either experiment are false, the run fails (worst value in every metric). The paper reports no false loops (Section VI-B).

_paper_results.note: Paper Table IV axis-averaged MAEs on 140 real GelSight Mini episodes (unchanged). The gym is a scaled synthetic substitute (160x120 at 0.1268 mm/px, 400-frame episodes), so these are not on the gym's scale and are kept here for context only.

long_horizon_tracking.results_note: results: reproduced reference and eval-owned baseline on the final 384-episode held-out test, regenerated end to end in isolation; same values as scoring/scores_test.json.
long_horizon_tracking.primary_metric_note: Primary label is the 95th-percentile rotation error: per-episode mean errors are heavy-tailed (a rare tracking loss that is never relocalised costs ~20 deg on one episode), so the tail metric is the stable headline across slices. Ranking uses every metric with the coefficients below; MAE keeps the largest coefficient.

relocalization_after_contact_loss.description: Tracking after contact loss (paper Section V-E, Fig. 11: 25 frames removed after every 100 kept frames). Held-out test: 192 synthetic episodes of 400 kept frames over four texture families. Scaled gym measurements are under results; unchanged paper context is under _paper_results.

rotation_mae_deg.description: Mean absolute rotation error, averaged over the three Euler axes (theta_x, theta_y, theta_z) and over frames, of sensor poses relative to the first frame; averaged over the contact-loss episodes. Same statistic as the paper's Table IV.

translation_mae_mm.description: Mean absolute translation error in millimetres, averaged over x, y, z and over frames, relative to the first frame; averaged over the contact-loss episodes (Table IV statistic).

rotation_p95_deg.description: 95th percentile over all frames of the contact-loss episodes of the geodesic rotation error (capped at 90 deg); catches tracking failures hidden by the mean.

translation_p95_mm.description: 95th percentile over all frames of the contact-loss episodes of the translation error norm in millimetres (capped at 30 mm).

false_loop_excess.description: Constraint: fraction of the method's reported frame-pair relations (one record per frame pair) whose relative pose disagrees with ground truth by more than 1 mm or 5 deg (malformed, non-finite, impossible or duplicate records fail the run), minus a 2% allowance for the verification tolerance, floored at 0. Methods that report no relations score 0. If more than 10% of a method's relations within either experiment are false, the run fails (worst value in every metric). The paper reports no false loops (Section VI-B).

_paper_results.note: Paper Table IV axis-averaged MAEs on 140 real GelSight Mini episodes (unchanged). The gym is a scaled synthetic substitute (160x120 at 0.1268 mm/px, 400-frame episodes), so these are not on the gym's scale and are kept here for context only. The paper reports the contact-loss study only graphically (Fig. 11: 'nearly identical' to full episodes); the GelSLAM value repeats Table IV and the paper gives no NormalFlow value.

relocalization_after_contact_loss.results_note: results: reproduced reference and eval-owned baseline on the final 384-episode held-out test, regenerated end to end in isolation; same values as scoring/scores_test.json.

_paper_context.note: Paper numbers on the real GelSight Mini dataset (140 episodes, 20 objects, 523 frames on average). The gym's synthetic episodes are 400 frames at 160x120 (0.1268 mm/pixel), so its absolute errors are on a different scale; only directions and relative effects are comparable.

settings.curvature_gaussian_filter: 7x7 at 320x240 (5x5 used at the gym's 160x120, as in the released code)
